findings.title: Plan execution authorization was unenforced
findings.fix: Bind deterministic local-only execution authorization into planning, bundle validation, and apply; protected external actions remain unavailable.

findings.title: Apply receipts could omit planned actions and verify early
findings.fix: Preallocate one immutable pending receipt row per action, require exact plan coverage, and reserve verified state for Verify.

findings.title: Subdirectory and empty-session identity bypass
findings.fix: Resolve the current Git top-level and require a non-empty session identity for mutation-authorized apply.

findings.title: Awaiting-review retirement lacked an R34a resume packet
findings.fix: Require a versioned external resume packet, validate all recovery and delivery identities, bind its identity and digest into the receipt, and revalidate before sweep.

findings.title: Cold gateway implicitly initialized high-water state
findings.fix: Keep protected mutation unavailable until an authenticated rollback-protected bootstrap seeds explicit current claims; reject unseeded resources.

findings.title: Same-epoch claim restore could regress generation and revision
findings.fix: Maintain per-resource high-water state outside snapshots and reject missing, lower, or same-generation different-revision restores.

findings.title: Final policy oracle lacked superseding provenance
findings.fix: Preserve slice-002 history and explicitly rebind slice-003 to the final reconcile-predicates/v2 SHA-256.
